building_height_datum.method: Rigidly translate surveyed roof returns by graded-minus-surveyed median footing before profiling

surface_field.coverage: Entire playable site, plus context road and pedestrian corridors; smooth 20m outer transition

businesses.selection: Complete porch-free ground floors; original corridor plus geographically spread local shops

neighborhood_shops.rule: Named low Old York stores, then low one-storey stores and addressed street-corner end units; >=85 m apart, >=40 m from existing businesses, >=12 m from civic sites

placement_notes: Landmarks/spawn lie on actual generated sidewalks. Decorative fixtures are fictional; widths are processing defaults unless OSM supplies width. Route crosses side streets. Terrain extent is a bounding box; use site_boundary for playable area.
